# Wordsmyth

> > Wordsmyth provides comprehensive English dictionaries, vocabulary tools, and educational resources designed for language learners of all ages.

Wordsmyth is an educational platform offering dictionary and thesaurus tools, writing analysis features, and specialized learning resources including WILD (Wordsmyth Illustrated Learner's Dictionary) for young children. The platform serves English language learners through interactive vocabulary-building tools and teacher-friendly educational products.

## Key Topics

- WILD (Wordsmyth Illustrated Learner's Dictionary)
- English dictionary and thesaurus
- Vocabulary building
- Text highlighter and readability analysis
- Readability metrics (Flesch-Kincaid, Coleman-Liau, SMOG, Gunning-Fog)
- Children's dictionary
- Early learning resources
- Picture dictionary
- Language learners
- Educational products
- Word Explorer
- Teacher tools
- Writing analysis
- English language learning

## Core Dictionary & Learning Tools

- [Wordsmyth Homepage](https://www.wordsmyth.net): Wordsmyth homepage: English dictionary and thesaurus for learners
- [Text Highlighter & Writing Tool](https://www.wordsmyth.net/text_highlighter): Wordsmyth text highlighter with readability metrics and writing support

## Children's Learning Resources

- [WILD: Word Explorer Children's Dictionary](https://kids2.wordsmyth.net/): WILD: Wordsmyth Illustrated Learner's Dictionary for K-2 children
- [WILD Dictionary Book Product](https://shop.wordsmyth.net/product/wild-book/): WILD product page: illustrated first dictionary for ages 4-7
